summary: stui shows behind and diverged on a running screen: it reads the sync notice when st connects and again, at most once a minute, while the graph moves, because the live stream's frames carry none

replay.detail: No claim replay or recovery behavior changes.

schema.detail: No tables, indexes, triggers, schema-version changes or data rewrites; the sync notice the server already sends is read, not changed.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or digest changes; no coordinated member upgrade required.

compatibility.detail: stui makes one extra one-row Attention page read when it connects to st, and again at most once a minute while later Attention or Agents frames arrive; an idle screen sends none. No server, schema or client contract change. To be removed when the stream carries the notice.

downtime.detail: Normal binary restart; no additional startup work.

manual.detail: No operator actions, client re-pairing or configuration changes required.

recovery.detail: No persistent state changes or new swap-back restrictions.
